Why one agent has no model

Mechanical, U12

The Mechanical lens is arithmetic: share count, currency translation, calendar effects. It costs nothing, it cannot hallucinate, and it is the one lens still standing when the API is unavailable — which is not hypothetical, because the API went down during this build and Mechanical was the only view that would still have produced a number. It also has an explicit insufficient-inputs path: a deterministic lens always answers, and under materiality weighting a lens that cannot decline would read as the most confident view in every run purely because it is the only one that cannot.

Why exactly one call runs on the deep tier

the judge, U23

The judge is the only agent that sees the full picture — every surviving view, what survived being argued against, the model's measured error, and an explicit list of which lenses are missing and why. That is the highest-leverage decision in the system and the only one worth the most capable model. The client raises before a second deep call rather than billing for it, and a test asserts the count.
